_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. Settings › Phone remote (Пульт на телефоні) and what Remote Control (Дистанційне керування) says in SoftPresenter's window (the address, password, remembered devices, wrong passwords, certificate notices), and the sentences the app's server says to the phone's page (sign-in answers, refusals, errors, a playlist item's words: remote.signin, remote.refused, remote.at_computer, remote.error, remote.item), kept short and plain; the phone's page has its own tables for its own words. Protocol words (hello, command, preview, args, JSON) and sp's own commands stay as typed. remote.day.format is a chrono date format, not words: Ukrainian writes 25.11.2026 (%d.%m.%Y). remote.wrong.many is said with one form for any number, so the count stands after a colon.
